ideas.pitch: A client-side coordinator that uses Nostr direct messages to negotiate collaborative Bitcoin CoinJoins without relying on centralized servers or leaking IP addresses.
ideas.title: NostrCoinJoin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Privacy and Nostr tracks by combining decentralized communication with sovereign Bitcoin privacy tooling, aligning with Bitshala's core ethos.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent running locally that monitors Lightning Network channel liquidity and rebalances balances automatically using signed Nostr event triggers.
ideas.title: SovereignAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the AI track with Bitcoin infrastructure, showcasing genuinely hard engineering around automated state management and cryptographic agent signing.

ideas.pitch: A privacy-preserving payment gateway built on Noir circuits that allows users to prove they have paid an ecash mint without revealing their blinding factors or transaction history.
ideas.title: ZeroProofPay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced zero-knowledge cryptography tailored for financial privacy, drawing from proven patterns of winning ZK hackathon submissions.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized peer-to-peer marketplace for open source intelligence and research data, where listings and escrow are entirely handled over Nostr relays with Lightning settlement.
ideas.title: NostrP2PStore
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits squarely into the Nostr track by building censorship-resistant communication and commerce infrastructure that cannot be taken down by an intermediary.

ideas.pitch: An encrypted AI assistant for Bitcoin developers that fetches BIP documentation and reviews script implementations locally via multi-party computation without exposing proprietary code to third-party LLM APIs.
ideas.title: BlindAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses critical privacy concerns in AI tooling, matching the winning pattern of secure multi-party collaboration platforms and capturing the AI and Privacy track overlap.
